rules.entry: Long-only expansion/breakout. Flat if IV>=50%. No shorts. Pause new entries if last 7 days P&L <= -2% equity.
rules.hold: Hold to +40% target. If still red at 6h, flatten. Hard cap 12h. Also -35% premium stop or 1h structure close. Weekly -2% pause. Fully automated.
rules.stop: 1h CLOSE beyond last confirmed lower-low / higher-high plus 0.5 ATR. Wicks ignored.
rules.safety: Flatten 60m before expiry. Daily 3% book halt still applies.
